description: A link that opens the photo tool for one document, so the user takes or uploads the photo on their own device. The photo is processed privately in the user's browser and is never sent through this connection: never ask the user for the photo here. Returns JSON text with 'url' (give it to the user), an 'instruction' sentence and an 'attribution' line.

client.description: Short lower-case name of the assistant for the link's utm_medium, e.g. 'claude', 'gemini', 'chatgpt'. Default 'assistant'.

locale.description: Language of the prose fields (title, summary, rules). One of: en, es, fr, de, pt, hi, ar, zh, ru, vi, tr, id, ja. Default 'en'. Official quotes and every number are identical in all languages.

slug.description: Document slug in the form '<country-slug>/<document-slug>', exactly as returned by find_document (for example 'united-states/passport', 'india/passport', 'schengen/schengen-visa'). The ISO-code form 'us/passport' is also accepted.

name: get_make_link
title: Get the link to make the photo on surepassportphoto.com
